[LSIG.2.3.4] **Recompute.** The eviction subtract is subject to subtractive
cancellation over long windows with slowly-varying signals. The runtime must
fully recompute $S$ ([LSIG.2.3.1]) from the live ring intervals every `K = 128`
evictions (`K` is a runtime constant, not stored in the atom). This is the
canonical running-sum recompute policy for DS series backings.
